title: knowledge(breaking-changes): adding a parameter to an event publisher is not a signature break
summary: The breaking-changes knowledge article now clarifies that adding a parameter to an event publisher is not a breaking change, since event subscribers bind by parameter name, not position. This aligns the article with the existing events knowledge and removes a false positive report.
key_points: Event subscribers bind to publishers by parameter name, not by position
Detection now skips event publishers whose only change is an added parameter and calls such reports false positives
Removals, retypes, renames and var flips on event publishers are still treated as breaking
Cross-references point to the events articles, including the cases where publisher access or adding IsHandled matters
quote: AL binds an event subscriber to its publisher by parameter name, not by position.
